description: Search non-Czech business registries by company name. Supported: GB (Companies House), SK (ORSR/RPO), PL (KRS), LT (JAR open data with VIES/GLEIF fallback), NL/IT/AT/ES/BE (GLEIF/LEI only; exact VAT data via lookup_company_by_vat or get_company with VAT), DE (GLEIF/LEI), FR (SIRENE), NO (BRREG), DK (CVR), FI (PRH YTJ), EE (RIK open data), SE (GLEIF/LEI name search; use get_company for full Bolagsverket data).

country.description: ISO alpha-2 code or supported country name, e.g. "GB", "UK", or "United Kingdom".

limit.description: Max results per search, default 10, max 20.

name.description: Company name or partial company name.

name: search_company
